title: Blooming Freedom
author: Santasree Choudhury
text:
Nothingness
Is It Nihilistic Freedom ..
Experience Of Spiritual Emptiness
Or
Entering A Void Of Invisible Silence ...

From The Dark Muddy Water
Blooms The Lotus Flower ..
Submerged Beauty
Awakens Gracefully
Draped In Untouched Pristine Purity
Blossoms
Displaying Essence Of Reality ..
Enlightened Eclectic Spontaneity ...
Sacred Femininity Of Flowering Philosophy
Amidst
Sounds Of Secretive Sutra
Presence Of Pearl White Morning Dew On
Dark Green Glossy Lily Pads
Focus
Ultimate Floating Manifestation
Sacred Finality Of Unknown Scriptures
Display
Liberating Mind Of Awakened Buddha ....
stanzas: Entering A Void Of Invisible Silence ...
Presence Of Pearl White Morning Dew On
